D. excessively big or heavy. --3 Having full power.

m: अन्-ऊन—गुरु mfn. of undiminished weight, very heavy.

a: अनूप्य — a. [अनूपे देशे भवः, यत्] Being in a pond or bog.

v: anUrADa
tri॰ anu + rADa--zaY upasa॰ dI॰ । anurADanIye “indraM vayamanUrADaM havAmahe” iti aTa॰ 19, 15, 2 ।
m: अनू-राध mfn. causing welfare, happiness, AV.
अनू-राध (आस्), m. f. pl. = -अनु-राधास्, q.v., TS.; TBr.; Kāṭh.
अन्-ऊर्ध्व mfn. not high, low.
a: अनूर्ध्व — a. Not high, low; ˚भास् Ved. whose splendour does not rise, who lights no (sacred) fires.

m: अन्-ऊर्ध्व—भास् (अन्-ऊर्ध्व-), mfn. one whose splendour does not rise, who lights no sacred fires, RV. v, 77, 4.
अन्-ऊर्ध्वं-भावुक n. not rising upwards, not reaching the heaven, TS.
अन्-ऊर्ध्व-ज्ञु mfn. not raising the knees, ŚāṅkhGṛ.
अन्-ऊर्जित mfn. not strong, weak
not proud.
a: अनूर्जित — a. 1 Not strong, weak, powerless. --2 Free from pride.

m: अन्-ऊर्मि mfn. ‘not waving or fluctuating’, inviolable, RV. viii, 24, 22.
a: अनूर्मि — a. 1 Not waving, unruffled by waves, not fluctuating. --2 Inviolable.

s: anUruH
puM, (nAsti UrU yasya saH .) sUryyasAraTiH । aruRaH । ityamaraH ॥ (UruhInaH .) ॥
v: anUru

pu॰ na sta UrU yasya ba॰ । sUryyasAraTO vinatAjyezWaputre aruRe । tasya apUrRe eva garBe mAtrA aRqasya sTowanAdUrupraBftfdBAvakalatvam gatkaTA BA॰ Adipa॰ । yaTA “tataH putrArTinI devI vrIqitA ca tapasvinI । aRqaM biBeda vinatA tatra putramapaSyata । pUrvvArdDakAyasampannaBitareRAprakASatA । sa putraH kroDasaMrabDaH SaSApEnAmiti SrutiH । yo'hamevaM kfto mAtastayA loBaparItayA । SarIreRAsamagreRa tazmAddAsI Bavizyasi । paYcavarzaSatAnyasyA yayA vizpardDase saha । eza ca tvAM suto mAtarddAsItvAnmocayizyati । yadyenamapi mAtastvaM mAmivARqaviBedanAt । na karizyasyanaNgaM vA vyaNgaM vApi yaSasvinam । pratipAlayitavyaste janmakAlo'sya DIrayA । viSizwaM balamIpsantyA paYcavarzaSatAtparaH । evaM SaptvA tataH putro vinatAmantarIkzagaH । aruRo dfSyate brahman praBAtasamaye sadA । AdityaraTamaDyAste sAraTyaM mamakalpayaditi” । “gataM tiraScInamanUrusAraTeriti” mAGaH ।
m: अन्-ऊरु mfn. thighless
अन्-ऊरु m. the charioteer of the sun, the dawn, Rājat. &c.
a: अनूरु — a. [न. ब.] Thighless. --रुः Aruṇa, the charioteer of the sun (who is represented as having no thighs); the dawn; see अरुण. --Comp. --सारथिः the sun (having अनूरु for his charioteer); गतं तिरश्चीनमनूरुसारथेः Śi. 1. 2.

m: अनू-रुध् mfn. = अनु-रुध्, q.v., RV. iii, 55, 5.

s: anUrusAraTiH
puM, (anUruH aruRaH sAraTiH raTacAlako yasya saH .) sUryyaH । yaTA, -- “gataM tiraScInamanUrusAraTeH” । iti mAGaH ॥
v: anUrusAraTi
pu॰ anUruH sAraTiH raTaniyantA yasya । sUryye tatkaTA'nupadamuktA ।
m: अन्-ऊरु—सारथि m. whose charioteer is Anūru i.e. the sun, Śiś.
अनूत्था (√ स्था), अनूत्तिष्ठति to rise after, VS. &c.
अनू˚त्थान see अन्-अनूत्थ्˚ (add.).
अनूत्थातृ m. an attendant, Jaim.

v: anUta
strI ve--ktin aBAve na॰ ta॰ । gamanABAve । “astUtI anUtI hiriSipraHsatvA” iti f॰ 6, 29, 6 । “anUtyA anAgamaneneti” BA॰ ।

m: अन्-ऊति f. no help, RV. vi, 29, 6.
a: अनूतिः — f. [वे-क्तिन्, न. त.] Not coming or going (to aid) (अनागमनं).

m: अनूत्-√ क्रम् to go up or out after, ŚBr.
1. अनूत्-√ 1. पा -पिबति, to drink up or empty by drinking after another, ŚBr.
2. अनूत्-√ 5. पा (3. pl. -पिपते) to rise along, TBr. (cf. उत्- √ 5. पा.)
अनूत्-√ पत् to fly up after another (acc.), raise one's self into the air, jump up afterwards.
अनूत्-सारम् ind. while leaving a place or retiring successively, AitBr.
अन्-ऊत्सर्ग m. non-abandonment, Āpast.
अनूत्-√ सृज् to dismiss towards, TS.
अनू-वृज् only du. -वृजौ m. f. a part of the body near the ribs, AV. ix, 4, 12.
a: अनूवृज् — m. Ved. A part of the body near the ribs.

v: anUyAja
pu॰ anu + yaja GaY upasargasya vA dIrGaH । anuyAjArTe ।
m: अनू-याज = अनु-याज, q.v., TS.
a: अनूयाज, अनूराध — = अनुयाज, अनुराध.

m: अन्-ऊषर mf(आ)n. not salted, not saline, ĀśvGṛ.; Hcat.
a: अनूषर — a. 1 Saline, the same as ऊषर; cf. उत्तम and अनुत्तम. --2 Not saline.

m: अन्-ऊष-रिह् mfn. not licking salt, MaitrS.
अनूषित mfn. (√ 5. वस् with अनु), living near another, Pāṇ. iii, 4, 72, Sch.
अन्-ऊष्मन् mfn. not aspirated, APrāt.
अन्-ऊष्म-पर mfn. (in Gr.) not followed by a sibilant.
